name: Louise Easen
bioAdditions: Louise Easen was born in England on 4 Aug 1878 to Thomas Easen (1848-1932) and Mary Barnes (1850-1921) and came to America as an infant (1879/80). She married Thomas F. Heffernan on 20 Jun 1900 (Luzerne marriage index as "Louisa Essen"), was living in Wilkes-Barre in 1950, and died in Philadelphia on 16 Jun 1960 (S1).
